arguments.text: 8000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250,2500,3750,5000,6250,7500). Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: check pod power against heart rate and GPS speed leg by leg (pod drift -> set pod_gain); (2) spot drag/weed (push_local drop within a leg, pacer clears) and current/wind changes; (3) radio messages: course changes -> set_race_distance + tell; (4) critical power check from heart-rate trend after minute 5; (5) finish: pacer only pushes if pod reserve >40 pct under 800 m; if reserve is 15-40 pct consider a piece (+effort) in last ~600 m. Use legs() and measure() every few minutes.
